global_stop_rule: No claim frontier is closed by a negative alone. A negative closes only the failed realization; the frontier continues through a materially different successor, parent assimilation, representation change, or proof that the stronger claim is unnecessary/impossible in the registered ORION scope. A later governance audit may narrow a historical positive interpretation without deleting the original receipt.
